text.en: Pet owners consistently commend the team at Stoke Newington, highlighting veterinarian Rachel and staff member Basila for their reassuring support. Reviewers praise the practice for its friendly, polite customer service, attentive listening, and genuine dedication to patient welfare.

Clients describe a welcoming environment where dogs and cats are handled gently. Reviewers appreciate that clinicians take the time to settle nervous animals, offering careful examinations and helping with routine pet maintenance such as nail clipping in a low-stress manner.

Recent feedback highlights efficient scheduling, with pet owners appreciating prompt dispensing of prescriptions and short-notice bookings. Clients report that the clinic accommodates urgent cat examinations and time-sensitive travel health certificate requests smoothly.

q.en: Can appointments be booked on short notice for urgent checks?

a.en: Yes, reviewers note that the clinic has accommodated urgent pet checkups and short-notice travel consultations promptly.

q.en: Does the practice assist with overseas pet travel documentation?

a.en: The practice provides rabies vaccinations and prepares Animal Health Certificates required for travel to the European Union.

q.en: What procedures can be performed at Stoke Newington?

a.en: The surgery delivers preventative health checks, dental procedures, diagnostic ultrasound, and soft tissue surgeries.

q.en: Is parking available near the Green Lanes surgery?

a.en: Yes, parking facilities are available for clients visiting the clinic on Green Lanes in Newington Green.
